items.title: New Gemini Robotics vision-language-action model reported
items.summary_en: SiliconAngle reports DeepMind released a new robotics model described as its most capable vision-language-action model so far, around November 10-11. It reports a 96% success rate packing automotive parts in Mercedes-Benz proof-of-concept tests.
items.notes: Secondary source. The article's version naming is inconsistent (next-generation vs 2.5), so the model name is unconfirmed. Date approximate. Find the official DeepMind post to confirm.
